messages.content: Predict a human’s investment in a repeated four-person decision experiment. The same four group members stay together for15rounds and may not communicate. Each round you receive50experimental dollars (ED). Put an amount from0to50into Account1; the rest goes to a private account returning1ED per unit. LetGbe the four simultaneous Account1 investments added together. Account1 surplus is6G−0.025G² ED. Your share of Account1 surplus is proportional to your investment (harvest effort). Your round earnings are50−your investment+your investment×(6−0.025G); the extra term is zero if everyone invests zero. Choices in the current round are simultaneous; current group investment and payoff are not yet known. Afterward your final round earnings are shown. Every1ED converts toUSD0.01 and the show-up payment isUSD5; all round earnings are paid. The history below lists only your earlier investment and final payoff (round/investment/payoff). Predict your current Account1 amount. Output only the number of ED invested.
